item.title: No nation is above the law: Iranian MP tells BRICS Forum
item.description: Tehran, IRNA – The head of Iran's parliamentary delegation to the 12th BRICS Parliamentary Forum said the global order must be based on the rule of law, stressing that no country should consider itself above the law.
item.content:encoded:

Tehran, IRNA – The head of Iran's parliamentary delegation to the 12th BRICS Parliamentary Forum said the global order must be based on the rule of law, stressing that no country should consider itself above the law.

item.title: Baqaei: Tehran meeting to focus on endogenous security
item.description: Tehran, IRNA – Foreign Ministry spokesperson Esmaeil Baqaei says that Tehran will host senior officials from Saudi Arabia, Pakistan, and Turkey later on Monday, with regional security topping the agenda of the talks. He says that the discussions could pave the way for measures to ensure security in West Asia through regional efforts.
